target_customer: Small businesses and individuals who want a website, payments and simple operations built by chatting with AI
problem: Building or redesigning a business website is slow and manual. The founders found that nobody finished a site in their first drag-and-drop builder.
business_model: SaaS subscription tiers ($25, $100, $200 per month) plus card processing fee of 2.9% + 30 cents
product_category: AI website and web app builder

founders.name: Ben Shumaker
previous_startups: An earlier drag-and-drop website builder built during YC S23 (never launched successfully)
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no education or employers.

founders.name: Izak Fritz
previous_startups: An earlier drag-and-drop website builder built during YC S23 (never launched successfully)
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no education or employers.

technical_complexity.rationale: Wrapping LLMs to import and regenerate websites is standard engineering in 2023, with hard parts in site import fidelity and building payments, accounts and email in one platform.

defensibility.rationale: AI website builders were being launched by many teams and incumbents such as Wix and Framer could add similar features; little proprietary data or lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found of incumbents buying or copying Repaint specifically; AI features were widely added across builders.

market_need_then: Demand for AI site creation grew after ChatGPT in 2023, but the founders reported their first non-AI builder saw few completed sites. No spend data found.

branding.domain_note: Uses repaint.com (exact .com); acquisition history not found.

identity.visual_style: Bright saturated colors with rounded mesh-style graphics (observed on the site)

branding.community_and_virality: Launched on Product Hunt and with a YC launch post; no merch or fan content found.

brand_strength.rationale: A clear real-word name that fits the redesign wedge, but a common word shared with unrelated paint products and apps, and no press on the brand itself.

pivots.from: Drag-and-drop Figma-inspired website builder built during the YC S23 batch
pivots.to: AI website builder focused on redesigning existing sites
pivots.why: Per the founders, nobody finished a site because it was too much manual work.

pivots.to: AI platform for websites, payments, email and custom software
pivots.why: Company site now says it is more than a website builder; date not stated.

outcome_analysis: Repaint pivoted within its YC batch from a manual drag-and-drop builder to an AI chat builder after seeing users fail to finish sites, and has since widened into payments, email and custom software with paid plans. It remains active with a tiny team. Funding data is thin and conflicting, so traction and outcome remain unclear.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights (listed under AutoEmber) shows about $500K over two rounds (June 2023 convertible note, August 2023 seed with Unpopular Ventures); Dealroom shows $125K; everydev shows $130K. All aggregators, so none recorded as rounds. The product page has no founders named; YC page names the two. The founders also have other YC launches (AutoEmber, Vigilant) whose relation was not confirmed. A trademark record for REPAINT belongs to an unrelated paint company. No competitor source dated near the batch was found, so the list is empty. The success factor successful_pivot is a judgment from the founders' own account, not from revenue data.
